correctness.rationale: For arbitrary five positive exterior turns summing 2pi, semicircle compatibility gives exact adjacency and diagonal pair tests; no two failed adjacency tests can be at cyclic distance two. No failures yields a graph C5, sharp vertex incidence lower bound ceil(5m/2) and explicit cyclic covers. One or two neighboring failures yield a three-vertex incompatibility clique, sharp lower bound 3m and explicit three-direction covers. Strict inequalities handle equality without perturbation. Every illuminated vertex direction illuminates incident edges, so the whole boundary is covered. Exact-integer checker passed 26277 configurations and all 31 incidence profiles m=1..4; these finite tests are supplementary.

value.rationale: A sharp natural complete classification of every integer multiplicity and the fractional threshold for the smallest unconstrained odd polygon beyond a triangle addresses the source's arbitrary-polygon problem. A precise consecutive exterior-angle threshold and tight three-vertex obstruction distinguish two real geometric regimes; the equality boundary and all-m exactness are essential rather than routine increments. No generalization to higher vertex counts or full optimizer classification is claimed.
